# NTS Distillers

NTS Distillers is the public website for NTS Blenders and Distillers Pvt. Ltd., a spirits manufacturer and contract bottling partner with a Goa manufacturing facility and roots in Pondicherry beverage distribution.

## Primary URLs

- Home: https://ntsdistillers.com/
- Product collection: https://ntsdistillers.com/products
- Goa distillery facility: https://ntsdistillers.com/distillery
- About NTS: https://ntsdistillers.com/about
- Achievements: https://ntsdistillers.com/achievements
- Contact: https://ntsdistillers.com/contact
- FAQ: https://ntsdistillers.com/faq
- Responsible drinking: https://ntsdistillers.com/responsible-drinking
- Privacy policy: https://ntsdistillers.com/privacy
- Terms: https://ntsdistillers.com/terms
- Cookie policy: https://ntsdistillers.com/cookie-policy

## Business Summary

NTS Blenders and Distillers Pvt. Ltd. operates in spirits manufacturing, contract bottling, bonded warehousing, and proprietary IMFL brands. The company story begins with NTS Wines in Pondicherry in 1980 under Mr. N.T. Sambath and now includes a Canacona Industrial Estate facility in Goa.

## Facility Facts

- Facility: Canacona Industrial Estate, Goa, India
- Goa property: 3 acres
- Current monthly production capacity: 75,000 cases
- Current bonded warehouse capacity: 25,000 cases
- Future monthly production plan: 2,50,000 cases

## Product Categories

- Whisky
- Brandy
- Rum
- Vodka
- Flavored vodka
